newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NYMEX crudes bounces from New York, Brent silent.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crudes bounces from New York, Brent silent.

text.p: NYMEX crude futures, trading on the out-of-hours ACCESS system were slightly higher at midday on Tuesday in Asia in a slight pull back from recent losses.
SIMEX Brent was untraded and unquoted at midday on SIMEX after London settled at $18.09 per barrel for a decline of three cents.
ACCESS August crude prices rose as high as $19.39 in a bounce from New York's nine cent loss, which followed a 72-cent fall on Friday.
However, the gains were short lived as ACCESS prices fell back again to last traded at $19.26, just six cents above the intraday low, for a gain of eight cents from New York.
